name: Hansen Advertising, Inc.
old_description: Hansen Advertising Inc. is a family owned & operated business located in Willmar, MN offering custom imprinted promotional products to create a recognizable brand identity for you. The business was founded in 1962 and is in its third generation of ownership. Although the industry has changed over the years, we still operate under the core belief that it is the relationships with people that make the difference. Our salespeople frequently attend industry trade shows and education seminars to stay abreast of the latest trends. Our in-house graphic artist can assist you in creating a logo or give your current logo a new look. about:
Hansen Advertising, Inc. has operated from Willmar, Minnesota since its founding in 1962. The company remains family owned and operated, now in its third generation of ownership. The business began as a promotional products supplier and has maintained a focus on personal relationships as its guiding principle.

The firm sources and customizes a full line of promotional products, sportswear, and business apparel for clients ranging from schools and churches to corporations. An in-house graphic artist assists with logo creation and artwork preparation, while a physical showroom allows customers to examine samples before ordering. Sales representatives attend industry trade shows and seminars to stay current on product trends and can deliver or mail samples directly to clients.

Hansen serves a broad base of organizations, including educational institutions, religious groups, general businesses, and event planners. The company has developed programs for meetings, conferences, product launches, sports events, and employee or volunteer appreciation. Recent blog content highlights specialized offerings for casino nights, wedding favors, and team recognition awards.

The company emphasizes its relational approach, stating that relationships with people make the difference. Its sales team works to align product selections with client budgets, values, and recipient preferences, aiming to deliver custom-imprinted items on time and within budget.
